detail.name: Super Duper Skin Swapper
detail.desc:
**{#00ff00}(v4.0: added search.)**

**{#00ff00}(Tip: [Fast Black Market Reload](https://modworkshop.net/mod/59090) and [WeaponFactoryManager Overrides/Forbids Caching](https://modworkshop.net/mod/55051) will make the weapon customization UI much faster.)**

Super Duper Skin Swapper allows any skin (and weapon color) to be used on any weapon. Filter buttons are added to the weapon customization UI to find skins by rarity, safe, and weapon category. Individual filters can be reset by right clicking.

Weapon UI updates are slow for guns with a lot of attachments. This is a base-game issue. The [Fast Black Market Reload](https://modworkshop.net/mod/59090) mod combined with [WeaponFactoryManager Overrides/Forbids Caching](https://modworkshop.net/mod/55051) fix this. Applying skins and changing filter settings will become almost instant with these optimizations installed.

Some legacy features of SDSS are now provided by [Optional Skin Attachments](https://modworkshop.net/mod/25474) and [Hide Duplicate Skins](https://modworkshop.net/mod/26920). They can be downloaded in-game via the SDSS options menu and include presets for use with SDSS. OSA is needed to use (legendary) skin-included attachments, and HDS is needed for duplicate hiding.

**__How Search Works__**

Searching has been added in SDSS 4.0. Search terms are separated by spaces. Every term must match the beginning of a word in the **skin name** or **weapon name**. Terms can match across both names and capitalization doesn't matter.

- All terms must match, but order doesn't matter.
	- Example: `safe car crash` and `car crash safe` both find the CAR-4 Safe Crasher.
- Matches must be at the start of a word.
	- Example: `safe crash` finds the CAR-4 Safe Crasher, but `safe ash` does not.
- Special characters are handled flexibly and can usually be left out.
	- Example: `car-4`, `car 4`, and `car4` all find CAR-4 skins.

Search works like a normal filter but the search is not saved when restarting or reloading the game. Right-clicking the search button resets the search, just like any other filter.

**__Acknowledgments__**

Credit goes to SAR_Boats for writing the original Super Skin Swapper.

Big thanks to Kamikaze94 for updating WolfHUD to be compatible with this mod.

Thanks to GreenGhost21 for feedback during development.

Many thanks to Ludor Experiens and △urelius for their fixes that kept this mod alive between U201 and U205.

Many thanks to [6IX] for the U242 fixes.

mod.name: Optional Skin Attachments
mod.desc:
This mod allows you to choose which attachments to use when applying weapon skins and provides improved support for legendary skins. Main features:

- **Choose Skin Attachments:** Replaces the apply/remove skin confirmation dialog with a menu that allows you to choose which attachments to use. Attachments that are part of the skin will show up as "Available" to use while the skin is applied (as is the case in the base game).
- **Customize Legendary Skins:** Allow first-generation legendary skins to be fully customized. Legendary attachments will be shown in the weapon customization menu and can be used if the corresponding skin is equipped. OSA can integrate with [Add-On Legendary Attachments](https://modworkshop.net/mod/27211) to automatically switch between real and add-on attachments depending on availability.
- **Enhanced Preview Options:** Option to enable dialog menus for choosing wear and weapon modifications in previews.
- **Default Color Settings:** Choose a default paint scheme, color wear, and pattern scale for weapon colors.

**__Additional Changes__**

- Fixes a bug in the base game where skins were not being sorted correctly.
- Allows all legendary skins to be renamed.
- Various fixes to prevent clipping/missing weapon parts when customizing legendary weapons.
- Displays a visual indicator when players use swapped skins.

**__Known Issues__**

- U242 made the Don Pastrami Barrel block the Iron Sight. OSA removes the restriction. However, players without the mod will not see the Iron Sight on your gun and they will see you with -2 concealment.
- U242.1 made the Demon Barrel block suppressors. OSA removes this restriction. However, players without the mod will not see suppressors on your gun and they will see you with increased concealment. Your gunshots will sound loud to them but the silencer effect still works. You will not alert guards when shooting, even as a client.

If you use Add-On Legendary Attachments, the add-on versions of these attachments appear as default parts and do not have this issue for vanilla players.

**__Compatibility__**

- Optional Skin Attachments is compatible with [Hide Duplicate Skins](https://modworkshop.net/mod/26920).
- Optional Skin Attachments v4.0+ is compatible with [Super Duper Skin Swapper](https://modworkshop.net/mod/26919) v3.0+.

**__BeardLib Features__**

BeardLib is not required for OSA, but if BeardLib is installed, OSA will load some textures and models to improve the visual behavior of legendary attachments. This shows up in the BeardLib mods manager as "OSA Assets".

- Platypus Beak Suppressor: prevents the Beak Suppressor from glitching out when equipped on the Don Pastrami Barrel. (Originally from AOLA, thanks to Hoppip and Mercu for helping with the model).
- Kobus 90 default barrel: hides the default Kobus 90 barrel when using the Alamo Dallas Body Kit.
- Astatoz Barrel: fixes the attachment point for barrel extensions to make it centered. Courtesy of AkiraDragunDaishiyu.
- Big Kahuna Barrel: fixes the attachment point for barrel extensions so it's actually connected to the gun and not floating (also in third person). Courtesy of AkiraDragunDaishiyu.

In addition, icon textures will be loaded with BeardLib instead of using Lua fixes (they appear the same as without BeardLib).

If you don't have BeardLib, the Astatoz and Big Kahuna are also available as mod_overrides from the original modpage [here](https://modworkshop.net/mod/53664).

mod.name: WeaponFactoryManager Overrides/Forbids Caching
mod.desc:
# Makes AK/M308 Scope Mount users stop lagging the game (or at least helps reduce it)

I originally made this for and ripped it from the dev-branch of Restroom-nation Mod

Mod that caches the overrides and forbids data of weapon blueprints as a means of reducing the hitching caused by doing a gorillion for loops looking through potentially giant f-off overrides and forbids tables every time certain functions get called.

From what others in the resmod community and I have (briefly) tested, it helps with reducing (and reportedly outright removing in some cases) the hitching and stuttering when:

* Highlighting attachments in the weapon mod menu of a kitted out weapon/a weapon using attachments with giant override/forbid table.
  * there may still be lag but AFAIK this is from the UI grabbing stats for the attachments
* Switching to and from the underbarrel of a kitted out weapon/a weapon using attachments with giant override/forbid tables
* In-heist when connected clients switch to a kitted out weapon/a weapon using attachments with giant override/forbid tables (notice a trend?)
  * Mainly for the dreaded AK/M308 scope mounts and any other similarly set up attachment that has an override for every optic in the game

The mod will also clear the cache whenever a blueprint change is done as to avoid storing and using stale data.

If there are any adverse effects stemming from this do toss a report.

mod.name: SuperBLT 64-bit Beta
mod.desc:
# SuperBLT Beta for 64-bit PAYDAY 2

This is a beta release of SuperBLT, ported to the 64-bit release of PAYDAY 2.

While most of the functionality is working, a few things aren't finished yet:

* XAudio: **CURRENTLY WORKS**. This is in the process of having the backend be ported to play all audio via the game's native WWise audio engine, but this will not impact how mods work or are made.
* Misc. recent features from the 32-bit DLL: these were lost due to the history of the 64-bit port, which was forked from RAID BLT. Some changes were made to SuperBLT after RAID BLT forked from it, and these haven't been ported forwards yet.
* DLL Plugins: completely untested, may or may not work. No stable API yet.

# Installation instructions

Download the ZIP, and copy the DLL into your game folder. The README.txt file contains instructions on this.

If you are updating from a 32-bit SuperBLT installation, delete the 'base' folder inside the 'mods' folder. This will be automatically re-downloaded when you start the game for the first time.

detail.desc:
{#FF5F1F}(**This mod has two versions - 64bit and 32bit version
Clicking on big button on the right downloads 64bit by default, this version will crash if you switched to Legacy branch on Steam
In that case, you need to download 32bit. Click on Downloads tab and download it there
Please note that 32bit version has no auto updates, therefore you need to reinstall EHI to keep receiving updates and fixes if you switch back to 64bit version (Diesel 3.0)
Your settings will be kept intact**)

Do you want to just see codes and other info ? Download **Codes and Info** standalone [here](https://modworkshop.net/mod/59204).

**Please do not run both EHI and standalone versions at the same time.
Mods share the same codebase and game may crash.
Tracking elements in standalone versions is already included in EHI.**

**Minimum game version required: 1.0.0-158409 (Update 247)
Minimum SuperBLT version required: v1.5.0 (Lua) and [4.0.1-beta](https://modworkshop.net/mod/58342) (DLL)
Minimum EHI version to sync data to other EHI players: r427**
**!!! Failing to meet the minimum requirements will cause crashes in-game !!!**

Shows trackers for various heist related gameplay elements
- Waiting for a van/heli/boat
- Waiting for a C4
- Waiting for a thermite to finish
- Achievements*
- Achievements with progress (e.g.: "Another Way Out" achievement in Hell's Island)
- A chance for something to happen (e.g.: teargas, cooking chance)
- Mission XP Overview
- Buffs (skill or perk) and color them based on their action in-game
- Filter achievements tracked in EHI or for **The Secret** -> See progress filter in Achievements Page
- Damage hit markers or Floating health bars
- Hudlist
- etc...

See screenshots in the "Images" tab for more info and how it looks in-game.

EHI is using in-game panels and should be compatible with all HUD mods.
You can change x, y position in options to move it on the screen. The mod supports Ultra-Wide monitors.

**Accuracy**
Always accurate on host.
Clients should stay accurate within 1-3s range. It is recommended to install (on both host and client side players) [Slowmotion Manager](https://modworkshop.net/mod/18128) mod and remove all slowmotion effects that slows down time calculation.
Desync can also disallow some trackers to show up/update. There is nothing to prevent it.
If you drop-in to a heist, some trackers related to elements may not appear. This is because they are not synced when you drop-in. It can be improved, but it is unfixable.

**Trackers**
Some trackers are inaccurate and have orange color. These trackers can prematurely expire or expire late when an element (van, heli, ...) is interactable.

**Supported heists**
All vanilla heists are supported (Under the Hammer Heist (Update 248) is the latest vanilla heist). Custom heists are not supported due to I have to look into the map scripts and find elements that can be tracked. However, support for them may come at later date.

mod.desc:
# SuperBLT Beta for 64-bit PAYDAY 2

This is a beta release of SuperBLT, ported to the 64-bit release of PAYDAY 2.

While most of the functionality is working, a few things aren't finished yet:

* XAudio: **CURRENTLY WORKS**. This is in the process of having the backend be ported to play all audio via the game's native WWise audio engine, but this will not impact how mods work or are made.
* Misc. recent features from the 32-bit DLL: these were lost due to the history of the 64-bit port, which was forked from RAID BLT. Some changes were made to SuperBLT after RAID BLT forked from it, and these haven't been ported forwards yet.
* DLL Plugins: completely untested, may or may not work. No stable API yet.

# Installation instructions

Download the ZIP, and copy the DLL into your game folder. The README.txt file contains instructions on this.

If you are updating from a 32-bit SuperBLT installation, delete the 'base' folder inside the 'mods' folder. This will be automatically re-downloaded when you start the game for the first time.

# SuperBLT Beta for 64-bit PAYDAY 2

This is a beta release of SuperBLT, ported to the 64-bit release of PAYDAY 2.

While most of the functionality is working, a few things aren't finished yet:

* XAudio: **CURRENTLY WORKS**. This is in the process of having the backend be ported to play all audio via the game's native WWise audio engine, but this will not impact how mods work or are made.
* Misc. recent features from the 32-bit DLL: these were lost due to the history of the 64-bit port, which was forked from RAID BLT. Some changes were made to SuperBLT after RAID BLT forked from it, and these haven't been ported forwards yet.
* DLL Plugins: completely untested, may or may not work. No stable API yet.

# Installation instructions

Download the ZIP, and copy the DLL into your game folder. The README.txt file contains instructions on this.

If you are updating from a 32-bit SuperBLT installation, delete the 'base' folder inside the 'mods' folder. This will be automatically re-downloaded when you start the game for the first time.

# SuperBLT Beta for 64-bit PAYDAY 2

This is a beta release of SuperBLT, ported to the 64-bit release of PAYDAY 2.

While most of the functionality is working, a few things aren't finished yet:

* XAudio: **CURRENTLY WORKS**. This is in the process of having the backend be ported to play all audio via the game's native WWise audio engine, but this will not impact how mods work or are made.
* Misc. recent features from the 32-bit DLL: these were lost due to the history of the 64-bit port, which was forked from RAID BLT. Some changes were made to SuperBLT after RAID BLT forked from it, and these haven't been ported forwards yet.
* DLL Plugins: completely untested, may or may not work. No stable API yet.

# Installation instructions

Download the ZIP, and copy the DLL into your game folder. The README.txt file contains instructions on this.

If you are updating from a 32-bit SuperBLT installation, delete the 'base' folder inside the 'mods' folder. This will be automatically re-downloaded when you start the game for the first time.

Version 1.7.2

一、新增牌组：军械士 PRO（第 9 套）

军械士 PRO 以加特林为核心，用持续火力压住整条街。过热之前，它是最不讲道理的那把枪；过热之后，你得先找个掩体。

第 1 张
装配 1.5 秒后发动重甲突袭，描出 Vulcan 转轮机枪：护甲临时提升到 1250，弹药不消耗，伤害翻倍，移速降低 20%。装配期间无法开枪、无法奔跑，移速降低 50%。开火 0.5 秒后过热条开始积累，8 秒满。超过 70% 射速开始下降，90% 时降到 30%，超过 90% 后不再有伤害加成。满热后射速在 2 秒内降到 0 并强制停火；过热超过 90% 后，必须降到 50% 以下才能再次开火。护甲被打碎时技能结束。

第 3 张
护甲上限提升 20%。在重甲突袭效果期间，你的每一次射击都有 25% 的概率击穿盾牌；若成功击穿，这一次的伤害减少 45%。

第 5 张
护甲上限提升 30%。另外可以二选一：高速射击（前半段射速更快、过热也更快），或耐热枪管（过热更慢、需要更久的连续射击）。

第 7 张
持续射击时精准度会逐步提升，最多 50%（3 秒内），停火 2 秒后归零。护甲恢复时间缩短 10%；护甲被打碎时获得 2 秒无敌，冷却 15 秒。

第 9 张
重甲突袭期间护甲上限提升 35%；每击杀一名敌人，破甲无敌的冷却缩短 0.5 秒。之后在下方选择一条改装路线。

【第 5 张可选分支】
高速射击：过热条在 0% 到 50% 之间时，射速提升 50%，但这段时间过热积累速度翻倍。过热到 50% 之后射速开始快速下滑，70% 时降到原本的 80%，再过热到 100% 射速降到 0 并直接停火，不会再有额外的射击窗口。
耐热枪管：过热积累速度降低 30%，并且需要持续射击 1 秒后才开始积累（默认是 0.5 秒）。射速曲线保持默认。

【第 7 张可选分支】
超限枪管（需要高速射击）：你的射击可以击穿盾牌；过热低于 50% 时射速提升到 175%、过热积累提升到 250%；过热超过 50% 后射速降到 50%、伤害降低 25%；超过 70% 后不再能击穿盾牌。
超量护甲：重甲突袭期间，护甲上限从 1250 提升到 1750。
枪管冷却升级：过热条的降温速度提升 30%。
同步射击套件（需要耐热枪管）：射速固定为 800 发/分，一次射击打出 6 发弹药；过热积累提升 200%。

【第 9 张可选分支】
过载：过热条填满后，你依旧能以 50% 射速继续射击（装备超限枪管时是 75%）。代价是过热条的冷却速度降低 50%（前面选了枪管冷却升级则只降低 20%）；过热条满时伤害降低 25%；若第 7 张牌选择同步射击套件，过热条满时射速降为 450 发/分。
金蝉脱壳：重甲突袭期间再按一次天赋技能键，接下来 10 秒内不会积累过热。10 秒后直接结束效果，结束的瞬间触发一次不计冷却的破甲无敌。

二、极道 PRO（1.7.0 ，本次一并说明）

极道相信，濒死的人才最危险。血量越低，出手越狠；被逼到墙角的时候，反而是他们最不好惹的时候。

极道 PRO 保留原版极道牌组，把第 7 张换成了「狂暴」。

第 7 张
你的血量越低，护甲恢复速度越快。当血量低于 25% 时，你会获得最多 20% 额外护甲恢复速度。
狂暴：随时按下绑定键，立即回满血量，伤害提升 100%，随后以每秒 5 点的速度持续流血（逐帧扣除，不是一秒一跳）。期间受伤不再扣血，改为加快流血速度：单次伤害低于 150 时流血速度增加 5/秒，达到 150 时增加 10/秒。血量流到 20 点时结束，冷却 30 秒。

「狂暴」和军械士的「召唤加特林」共用同一个按键，在游戏设置里绑定为「天赋技能」即可。

三、加特林机制

- 新增预热系统：开火或右键瞄准时枪管开始旋转，射速从 15% 起步，2 秒内升到 100%。停火后保持 0.3 秒，再用 0.9 秒回落。高速射击时起步 25%、1.6 秒预热；超限枪管时起步 35%、1.3 秒预热、1.0 秒回落；同步射击套件 3 秒预热。
- 过热界面重做：改为两根竖条，左边预热、右边过热，底部对齐，预热条高度为过热条的一半。过热条颜色改成连续渐变（白 → 黄 → 红），不再到某个百分比才跳变；高于 90% 时改为平滑呼吸式闪烁。底框改为半透明，整体右移到屏幕 78% / 62% 处，不再遮挡视野。
- 同步射击套件射速规则：70% 以下恒定 800 发/分；70% 到 100% 线性降到 450 发/分；满热后还能再打 2 秒（450 发/分），之后停火。
- 过载窗口最长 15 秒。过载期间射速不再下降；中途停火超过 0.2 秒会立即中断，且必须等过热条完全归零才能再次开火。
- 高速射击与超限枪管的曲线统一：50% 之后线性下降。没有过载时降到 0 并停火；有「过载」时分别保底 50% 与 75%。
- 中弹音与碎裂音换成游戏原版的玻璃材质音效（从游戏 bank 中直接提取），4 个变体随机播放，连续命中按 0.15 秒限流。

================================================================

Version 1.7.2

I. New Perk Deck: Gunslinger PRO (Deck 9)

Gunslinger PRO is built around the minigun — sustained fire that pins down a whole street. Before it overheats, it is the most unreasonable gun in the game; after it overheats, you had better find cover.

Card 1
After a 1.5 second deployment you launch an armored assault and draw the Vulcan rotary machine gun: armor is raised to 1250, ammo is not consumed, damage is doubled, and movement speed is reduced by 20%. While deploying you cannot fire or sprint, and movement speed is reduced by 50%. The heat bar starts building 0.5 seconds after you open fire and fills in 8 seconds. Above 70% heat the fire rate begins to drop, reaching 30% at 90%; above 90% you no longer get the damage bonus. At full heat the rate drops to 0 within 2 seconds and the gun is forced to stop. Once heat has gone above 90% you must let it fall below 50% before firing again. The effect ends when your armor is broken.

Card 3
Armor cap increased by 20%. While the armored assault is active, every shot has a 25% chance to penetrate shields; when it penetrates, that shot deals 45% less damage.

Card 5
Armor cap increased by 30%. Additionally, choose one of two: Rapid Fire (faster fire rate in the first half, but faster heat buildup), or Heat Sink Barrel (slower heat buildup, but it takes longer to get going).

Card 7
Sustained fire gradually improves accuracy, up to 50% over 3 seconds, resetting 2 seconds after you stop firing. Armor regeneration time is reduced by 10%; when your armor breaks you gain 2 seconds of invulnerability with a 15 second cooldown.

Card 9
During the armored assault your armor cap is increased by 35%; each kill reduces the cooldown of your armor-break invulnerability by 0.5 seconds. You then pick one of the modification routes below.

[Card 5 branches]
Rapid Fire: between 0% and 50% heat your fire rate is increased by 50%, but heat builds twice as fast during that window. Past 50% the rate falls quickly, hitting 80% of normal at 70%, then dropping to 0 at 100% and stopping the gun immediately with no extra firing window.
Heat Sink Barrel: heat buildup reduced by 30%, and heat does not start accumulating until you have fired for 1 second (default is 0.5 seconds). The fire rate curve is unchanged.

[Card 7 branches]
Overdrive Barrel (requires Rapid Fire): your shots can penetrate shields; below 50% heat the fire rate rises to 175% and heat builds 250% faster; above 50% heat the fire rate drops to 50% and damage drops by 25%; above 70% heat your shots no longer penetrate shields.
Extra Armor: during the armored assault, the armor cap goes from 1250 to 1750.
Coolant Upgrade: the heat bar cools down 30% faster.
Sync Shot Kit (requires Heat Sink Barrel): fixed fire rate of 800 RPM, each shot fires 6 rounds; heat buildup increased by 200%.

[Card 9 branches]
Overload: when the heat bar is full you can keep firing at 50% fire rate (75% with the Overdrive Barrel). The cost is that heat cools 50% slower (only 20% slower if you took Coolant Upgrade). At full heat your damage is reduced by 25%. If card 7 is the Sync Shot Kit, the fire rate drops to 450 RPM at full heat.
Emergency Eject: during the armored assault, press the perk deck skill key again to stop heat buildup for 10 seconds. After 10 seconds the effect ends immediately, triggering one armor-break invulnerability that ignores its cooldown.

II. Yakuza PRO (since 1.7.0, documented here)

The Yakuza believe the man closest to death is the most dangerous. The lower your health, the harder you hit — and once they have you cornered, they are at their most unpleasant.

Yakuza PRO keeps the original deck and swaps card 7 for "Rage".

Card 7
The lower your health, the faster your armor regenerates. Below 25% health you gain up to 20% extra armor regeneration.
Rage: press the bound key at any time to instantly refill your health and gain 100% extra damage, after which you bleed out at 5 points per second (ticked per frame, not once per second). Damage taken during this time no longer drains health; instead it speeds up the bleed: a single hit below 150 adds 5/sec, and a hit of 150 or more adds 10/sec. The effect ends when your health bleeds down to 20 points. 30 second cooldown.

"Rage" and the Gunslinger's "Summon Minigun" share the same key — bind it to the perk deck skill in the game settings.

III. Minigun Mechanics

- New spin-up system: firing or aiming down sights starts spinning the barrel. Fire rate starts at 15% and ramps to 100% over 2 seconds. After you stop firing it holds for 0.3 seconds, then decays over 0.9 seconds. With Rapid Fire it starts at 25% and spins up in 1.6 seconds; with the Overdrive Barrel it starts at 35%, spins up in 1.3 seconds and decays over 1.0 second; the Sync Shot Kit spins up over 3 seconds.
- Heat HUD reworked into two vertical bars — spin on the left, heat on the right, bottom aligned, with the spin bar at half the height of the heat bar. The heat bar is now a continuous white → yellow → red gradient instead of snapping at fixed thresholds, and above 90% it pulses smoothly. The background frame is semi-transparent and the whole widget moved to 78% / 62% of the screen so it no longer blocks your view.
- Sync Shot Kit fire rate rules: a constant 800 RPM below 70% heat; from 70% to 100% it drops linearly to 450 RPM; at full heat you can keep firing for another 2 seconds at 450 RPM before the gun stops.
- The Overload window lasts at most 15 seconds. Fire rate no longer drops while it is active; if you stop firing for more than 0.2 seconds it ends immediately, and you must let the heat bar drain to zero before firing again.
- Rapid Fire and Overdrive Barrel curves are now consistent: they fall linearly after 50%. Without Overload they reach 0 and the gun stops; with Overload they floor at 50% and 75% respectively.
- Impact and shatter sounds now use the game's original glass material audio (extracted directly from the game's sound banks), with 4 variants played at random and a 0.15 second rate limit between hits.

Version 1.6.0 

一、新增牌组：冰球手 PRO（第 7 套）

第 1 张
对敌人造成伤害后获得 1 层持续治疗：每 0.3 秒回复 1 点生命值，共 10 次（3 秒）。1.5 秒内只能获得 1 层，层数可以无限叠加。只有身穿两件套西装或轻型防弹背心时才能获得。

第 3 张
每层回血提升到 2 点，共 10 次。获得 20% 额外生命值。生命值已满时，溢出的治疗按 50% 转为临时生命上限，最多为基础生命上限的 50%；生命值未满并持续超过 15 秒后清除，回满血时计时重置。不再限制护甲类型。

第 5 张
每层回血提升到 3 点，共 10 次。身穿西装或轻型防弹背心时，回血间隔从 0.3 秒缩短到 0.21 秒（加快 30%），临时生命上限再提高 25%（加上第 3 张的 50%，总计 75%）。

第 7 张
每层回血提升到 4 点，共 10 次。获得 20% 额外生命值。临时生命上限触顶时，额外获得 1 个永久回血「多巴胺」：和普通层一样每 0.3 秒回复一次，但跳数永不耗尽，一直保留到被第 9 张消耗或倒地为止。

第 9 张
每层回血提升到 4 点，共 14 次（4.2 秒）。受到致命伤害时消耗全部回血层抵消这一次伤害，每层获得 0.5 秒无敌（最多 2 秒），并清除临时生命上限，优先于技能树的最后手段。触发后 20 秒冷却；无敌期间无法获得新的回血层数；无敌结束后的 5 秒内，回血量降低 50%。

二、修复

- 客机（非房主）领队 PRO 大部分功能失效：战吼回血、小弟分担、AI 血量显示都不生效，只有自己当房主时才正常。

- 修复了行者的神经反射可能在某种情况下会导致闪避加成一直存在，即使切换牌组也会有加成。
- 为浪人增加一个限制，以防止在客机的情况下，同时获得浪人 PRO 和浪人本体的闪避加成。


Version 1.5.4

涉及战吼回血、分担扣血、AI 血量、激励中转、强制投降。

二、修复客机吼小弟不回血

客机端补了小弟归属登记（本地威吓入口直接记到本机玩家名下）。
房主广播血量时，客机端补了按 id 查小弟的路径。

移除模组自行处决小弟的整套流程（延迟击杀 + 补派发死亡事件）。
死亡交回原版处理，招募名额正常释放。

小弟被分担打到致命伤不再死亡，血量锁在 1 点。
触发锁血后，小弟血量低于 300 期间不再参与分担；回到 300 以上自动恢复。
平时不设血量门槛，任何血量都会帮玩家挡伤害。

如果还有客机相关的异常，带日志来：mods/logs/<日期>_log.txt，搜 [VPP-DBG]。

detail.name: United Offensive Plus: Enhanced Factions
detail.desc:
United Offensive Plus: Enhanced Factions is an expanded continuation of United Offensive Plus, introducing additional enemy types, expanded faction rosters, and customizable enemy spawning.

Originally focused on fixing spawning issues and improving compatibility, this enhanced version goes further by introducing more enemy variants and allowing players to customize which enemies appear during assaults.

The goal is to make every faction feel more diverse, challenging, and enjoyable to fight against.

Main Features
1. Expanded Faction Rosters
Additional enemy types are introduced across five factions:
* America
* Russia
* Zombie
* Murkywater
* Federales

2. Additional Enemy Types
* Regular Police Officers
* Hostage Rescue Teams (HRT)
* Sniper Teams
* ZEAL Heavy Snipers
* Phalanx / Winters Shields
* Marshal Marksmen
* Marshal Shields
* Halloween Headless Bulldozers
* Pre-U183 Medic Bulldozer

3. Customizable Spawn Difficulty
Players can configure the minimum difficulty at which different enemy types become available.

Available difficulty settings:
* Never Spawn
* Normal
* Hard
* Very Hard
* Overkill
* Mayhem
* Death Wish
* Death Sentence

The selected difficulty also applies to higher difficulties.

4. Expanded Faction Compatibility
Not every faction has its own dedicated model for every enemy type.
Where faction-specific models are unavailable, compatible vanilla PAYDAY 2 enemy models are reused to expand the available rosters.

5. Performance and Stability Improvements
Includes improvements to enemy spawning logic and compatibility, with testing focused on the 64-bit version of PAYDAY 2.

Important Notes
* Some enemy variants are faction-specific, while others reuse vanilla models.
* Certain standard SWAT, FBI, GENSEC, and ZEAL variants are currently America-only.
* The Pre-U183 Medic Bulldozer has an additional multiplayer asset requirement. See the compatibility instructions.
* Mods that modify the same GroupAI spawning systems may have compatibility conflicts.

Installation
The download includes both United Offensive Plus Enhanced and Tmod Base.
Extract both folders into your PAYDAY 2 mods directory. Keep them as separate folders.

Credits
This project builds upon the work of the original United Offensive contributors:
* TK7 
* Schrodinger_Sig
* GTTOP

Link to their original mod:
https://modworkshop.net/mod/23628
https://modworkshop.net/mod/39769

Enhanced, modified, and maintained by BlueRyzen.

Thank you to the original creators and the PAYDAY 2 modding community.

mod.desc:
# SuperBLT Beta for 64-bit PAYDAY 2

This is a beta release of SuperBLT, ported to the 64-bit release of PAYDAY 2.

While most of the functionality is working, a few things aren't finished yet:

* XAudio: **CURRENTLY WORKS**. This is in the process of having the backend be ported to play all audio via the game's native WWise audio engine, but this will not impact how mods work or are made.
* Misc. recent features from the 32-bit DLL: these were lost due to the history of the 64-bit port, which was forked from RAID BLT. Some changes were made to SuperBLT after RAID BLT forked from it, and these haven't been ported forwards yet.
* DLL Plugins: completely untested, may or may not work. No stable API yet.

# Installation instructions

Download the ZIP, and copy the DLL into your game folder. The README.txt file contains instructions on this.

If you are updating from a 32-bit SuperBLT installation, delete the 'base' folder inside the 'mods' folder. This will be automatically re-downloaded when you start the game for the first time.

F.A.Q:

!!!
Q: Is this compatible with public lobbies, and will I get a cheater tag from using this mod?
A: Yes, it's compatible with public lobbies, just make sure the host is cool with custom content. No, it shouldn't give you a cheater tag. BeardLib should handle all of this. 

Q: Are the weapons and attachments in this mod balanced?
A: I have tried my best to keep things under control. I personally don't think this mod is going to make or break your heist. If you feel that some stats are too overpowered or too underpowered, you can change it in the main.xml file.

Q: Where does this mod get its models and textures?
A: The vast majority are from PAYDAY 2, but there are some others that snuck in as well. This mod pulls assets from PAYDAY 2, PAYDAY: The Heist, RAID: World War II, and OVERKILL's The Walking Dead. This mod is vanilla-styled, not strictly vanilla assets only.

Q: Will you add attachments from legendary skins?
A: Nope. OVERKILL does not like this.

Q: Will you separate any parts of this mod or make anything standalone?
A: Probably not. I like having it all in one big package. You can disable the weapons from showing up in the buy menu.

Q: Why won't skin patterns show up on certain weapon attachments?
A: Some of these attachments are really old and were built on an older model tool. I don't have plans to go back and reexport these models.

Q: My game updated, my mods don't work, and now a bunch of my weapons are gone!!

mod.name: Bullet Offset (3D AIM)
mod.desc:
**Adds bullet offset so that bullets actually come from your gun instead of your face.**
Yes, the Payday gang have been spitting bullets at their enemies all this time. (They have been shot enough times to canonically do this)

**Bullets come from the actual weapon muzzle!** ![](https://storage.modworkshop.net/mods/images/oqeSqkstRc14jnbK4Kxkswxm2l61F6lGRbHPIM0m.webp)
 
**Bullets follow weapon rotation!** ![](https://storage.modworkshop.net/mods/images/wDh1PRWOt7kMhomLrRI6mjLgn84bUcWMRvQmpFGX.webp) **More preview .gifs available under Images!** 

Bullet offset is dynamic with the weapon viewmodel using the fire_object marker to position and rotate bullets. 

**-Bullets actually follow weapon lasers!** Lasers come from the weapon model, now bullets do too!
**-Height over bore is a thing now!** No more pixel peeking over obstacles with high mounted optics! 
**-Left side peeking is disadvantageous!** Unless you've flipped your viewmodel or are dual wielding!
**-Weapons shoot where they are actually pointing!** Cancel-shooting an inspect animation will shoot wherever the gun is pointed!
**-Shooting around corners is possible!** No need to expose yourself if you can get your weapon around the corner!
**-Akimbo weapons are fully supported!** Right and left gun have independent trajectories!
**-Special and underbarrel weapons are fully supported!** Be careful, explosive projectile hitboxes are hella big! 
**-Mod disables itself when in VR!** VR already has bullets coming from the gun!

**There are mod options toggles to control pretty much every aspect of the mod.**
**If aiming feels off to you, try playing with the first 3 mod options till you find something you like.**

**If you want a closer to vanilla aiming experience, try the "Bullets Travel to Aim Point" option!**
It makes it so that bullets will always try to hit where the middle of the screen is aimed. 
It uses a raycast from the middle of the screen, which calculates the angle the bullet needs to fired at to hit the raycast target from the offset point. 
-Weapon model rotation is added on top, so keep your weapon aimed forward or just turn rotation off if you dont like it.
-This also makes bullets line up with weapon lasers while using [Less Inacurate Weapon Laser](https://pd2mods.z77.fr/less_inaccurate_weapon_laser.html) by TdlQ or [Perfect View Laser](https://modworkshop.net/mod/59843) by [a.k.a. t3f](https://modworkshop.net/user/akat3f).

**Other mod recommendations:**
I highly recommend a mod that adds leaning like [ProperLean](https://modworkshop.net/mod/57640) by [Ari](https://modworkshop.net/user/fedoralovesu) or [Tactical Leaning](https://modworkshop.net/mod/22254) by [Offyerrocker](https://modworkshop.net/user/offyerrocker) to go with this mod. 
A useful add-on for ProperLean: [ProperLean Contextual](https://modworkshop.net/mod/59819) by [I AM GREEN](https://modworkshop.net/user/iamgreen)
Another cool mod you'd might want is [Smart Cover Peeking](https://modworkshop.net/mod/43796?) by [Hoppip](https://modworkshop.net/user/hoppip)

I made this because all my other favorite shooter games have this feature and it absolutely ruined my aim without it.

Mod loads from a main.xml. You can put the mod in **PAYDAY 2\mods** or **PAYDAY 2\assets\mod_overrides**. Auto-updates through the BeardLib menu.

**Note about WeaponLib and broken akimbo weapons**: Current WeaponLib has somewhat broken akimbo weapons. Both guns are supposed to shoot once per click, but with the current WeaponLib, only the right gun shoots once per click. **v1.1** of my mod is compatible with this and makes the bullet spawn alternate between right and left gun. 
If you want akimbo weapons to work properly, you need [WeaponLib Fixes 2.0](https://modworkshop.net/mod/58880) by [I AM GREEN](https://modworkshop.net/user/iamgreen) and any version of my mod higher than **v1.1**.

I consider the mod basically fully finished in its current state, dont expect any updates unless something breaks or someone asks for an update.
I also give everyone full permission to further develop the mod and to upload their own versions.

detail.desc:
JoyHUD is a futuristic HUD designed around a hacker-inspired, cyberpunk aesthetic. Its visual identity blends underground tech culture, digital interfaces, and tactical systems, creating the feeling of a mind software during the heists.

The design features dark backgrounds, sharp geometric shapes, angular panels, fragmented elements, technical typography, subtle glitch effects, and neon accents. It should feel modern, edgy, and slightly industrial, without becoming overly flashy or sacrificing readability.

The interface should feel alive and responsive, with visual elements adapting to the games info. Warnings, failed equipment, active objectives, threats, and completed actions should each have their own visual language.

The overall goal is to make JoyHUD feel less like a traditional game HUD and more like a hacker's tactical interface.

**Bugs:**
There may still be some minor visual bugs or inconsistencies in certain UI elements. I'll be gradually fixing and polishing these details as I continue testing the HUD across different heists

detail.name: Sombra - ECM POCKET
detail.desc:
Re-upload of my mod "Sombra - ECM POCKET". I lost access to my old account (trolot44), so this is the new official page. This version brings important fixes and works on the 64-bit (Diesel 3.0) update.

**What's new in v0.7?**

- Works on PAYDAY 2 64-bit / Diesel 3.0 (SuperBLT x64 + BeardLib)
- The deck no longer changes other perk decks (it was breaking the armor bonus of decks like Armorer)
- The skills now give the real values (most of them were stuck at their lowest level before)
- Descriptions now show the real numbers (no more "$multiperk" text on the shared cards)
- Removed a broken script and fixed the text file
- New custom icons for all 9 cards
- Cards 6 and 8 are now pure stealth: extra body bag, longer camera loops and a chance to stop pagers with melee kills (armor bag and doctor bag bonus removed)
- The deck now shows up in the Stealth and Versatile filters

**What does this mod?**

You are available to use the pocket ECM device with some nice skills.

**Level 1: Ups.. im hacking you**
- Unlock and equip the POCKET ECM DEVICE
- 45 % faster when you walk or run

**Level 2: Helmet Popping**
- Increased your head damage 25 %
- You reload SMGs 65 % faster

**Level 3: Undetected**
- 2 concealment
- 15 % less likely to be targeted when standing still and crouched
- You deploy and interact with deployables 4x faster

**Level 4: Blending In**
- 1 concealment
- -25 % of weight for your armor
- You gain 45 % more experience when you complete days and jobs

**Level 5: ¡Cuidado, están aquí!**
- You mark enemies for 5x longer
- Your chance to dodge is increased by 10 %
- You swap weapons 130 % faster

**Level 6: Clean Sweep**
- You can carry 1 extra body bag
- Increases your ammo pickup to 135 % of the normal rate

**Level 7: Sleight of Hand**
- You reload pistols 100 % faster
- You lockpick doors and deposit boxes 80 % quicker
- 40 % faster when you are crouched

**Level 8: Apagando las luces**
- Your camera loops last 20 seconds longer
- Killing a guard with a melee attack has a 25 % chance to stop his pager from going off
- You deal 5 % more damage. Does not apply to melee damage, throwables, grenade launchers or rocket launchers

**Level 9: ¡Volvamos a la Medianoche!**
- You can loop cameras from 10x the normal distance
- You answer pagers 5 % faster
- You bag corpses 15 % faster

Requirements: SuperBLT (x64) and BeardLib.

Note: You should not be flagged as cheater with this mod, but let me know if it is not so.
You can change the points cost of the skills in "skilltree.lua"

If there's something that you want to add or remove, let me know, i'll be so happy to help you.
